title: Legacy4J Resident Evil 2 Skin Pack
description: A Skin Pack for Legacy4J with over 20 skins from Resident Evil 2 Remake from 2019!
body:
A Skin Pack for Legacy4J with 20 skins from Resident Evil 2 Remake from 2019!
Includes Leon, Claire, Ada, Hunk, Mr. X, William Birkin and many more!

![Legacy4J Resident Evil 2 Skin Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9abd7322416398cddcedbadba571fde95bf65979_0.webp)

Requires:

[Legacy4J](https://modrinth.com/mod/legacy4j)

[Legacy Skins](https://modrinth.com/mod/legacy-skins)

[Customizable Player Models](https://modrinth.com/mod/custom-player-models)
